title: Air Supply · Making Love Out of Nothing at All
description: The complete supplied video with the blue-lit duo, acoustic guitar, white vintage car, brick street, picnic, petrol station, diner and closing silhouettes. Original music and two physical mouth-engine voices.

characters.name: Russell · the dramatic lead
characters.role: Physical lead, high melody and overlapping calls

characters.name: Graham · the answering voice
characters.role: Guitarist and lower physical refrain · approximate harmony
